newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Sales of 92,300 MT were two and one-half times the previous week and the 4-week average. The primary buyers were Ecuador (38,000 MT), Venezuela (10,600 MT), and Australia (10,500 MT).
Sales of 67,900 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for China (50,000 MT) and Australia (10,000 MT).

Exports of 93,200 MT were up 8 percent from the previous week and 44 percent from the 4-week average. Saudi Arabia (32,500 MT), Colombia (11,300 MT), Ecuador (10,500 MT), and the Dominican Republic (9,900 MT) were the major recipients.
